title: Card Tenure Bonus on Closing Cashback — Cartwise Shopper Payouts Training Notes
content:
## Training notes: card tenure bonus at closing

On a Cartwise Shopper Payouts account held on an Everyday Pay Card plan, a card tenure bonus raises the shared figure of the closing cashback settlement: an account whose latest plan change (or, when it never changed plan, its opening) was 24 or more whole months ago gets 5 percent more, one 12 to 23 whole months ago gets 2 percent more, and any other account gets nothing more.

**What is the shared figure, and how is the bonus applied?**
The shared figure is the capped statement month after it has been multiplied by the closing share. The bonus multiplies the shared figure by one plus the bonus rate: by 1.05 for the 5 percent bonus and by 1.02 for the 2 percent bonus. The figure is not rounded at this point.

**From which date is tenure counted?**
From the account's latest plan-change date. When the account has never changed plan, tenure is counted from its opening date. The count is in whole months up to the day of the closing.

**What are the bands?**

| Whole months since latest plan change (or opening) | Card tenure bonus |
|---|---|
| 24 or more | 5 percent more (rate 0.05) |
| 12 to 23 | 2 percent more (rate 0.02) |
| fewer than 12 | nothing more |

**Where exactly do the boundaries fall?** (hypothetical dates)

- Latest plan change on 10 March of one year, closing on 10 March two years later: 24 whole months, 5 percent more. Closing on 9 March two years later: 23 whole months, 2 percent more.
- Opened on 1 June, never changed plan, closing on 1 June one year later: 12 whole months, 2 percent more. Closing on 31 May: 11 whole months, nothing more.

**A hypothetical figure.** A shared figure of 10.00 on an account whose latest plan change was 30 whole months ago becomes 10.50; with 15 whole months it becomes 10.20.
